results.title: Black Snake
results.overview: Tae-sik is a so-called "Hit Man" of a gang. But after his boss dies, the gang falls apart; and during a power struggle, Tae-sik's close gang member Gi-sun is murdered. Gi-sun was like a big brother to Tae-sik so he vows revenge. With the help of the dirty cop, Detectvie Han, Tae-sik is introduced to a woman named Mae-hwa. She provides clues for the murder and the two bond over their search for the killer. But during their search, Mae-hwa asks too many questions and it rubs the wrong people the wrong way that makes her end up being in danger; and now it is up to Tae-sik to rescue her.

results.title: Stuffed
results.overview: The Farooqis have an unforgettable Christmas when a surprise bonus leads to a Lapland holiday, but things go downhill fast after a disastrous discovery.

results.title: Most Longest Day
results.overview: Four strangers are stranded in a vast Russian wilderness, with no memory of how they got there. As tensions rise and secrets unravel, their journey through forests and fields leads to a disturbing revelation about their fate.

results.title: Anaphylaxis
results.overview: After a severe allergic reaction, Ria must navigate the persistent anxiety and mistrust that linger in its aftermath, while those closest to her struggle to understand the fragility of her world.

results.title: Two-Sevenths
results.overview: A young man discovers a diary that begins to shape his life in unexpected ways, pushing him to question the true cost of his choices.

results.title: Blou Klip
results.overview: Follwing Screwjob, Mikey, along with his new partner Emma, are tasked to visit a drug house to find out why business been slow. There they find Miguel, the drug-lord of the area, and what they discover after that, proves dangerous for the future, and landscape of crime in Cape Town.

results.title: For a Friend: A Tale of Hidden Desires
results.original_title: Bir Arkadaş İçin: Saklı Arzuların Hikâyesi
results.overview: A shop that everyone knows, but no one dares to step into...  "FOR A FRIEND", an absurd dark comedy about neighborhood culture, hidden desires, and social taboos.  This short film reveals the hidden world behind Enver’s seemingly ordinary life.

results.title: Six Days in Spring
results.overview: Despite adversity, Sana wants her twins to have a spring vacation, but all her plans fall through. They secretly decide to stay in her former in-laws' villa on the Riviera, without telling anyone. Six days of sunshine that mark the end of innocence.

results.title: The Fall of Prince Andrew
results.overview: Andrew Mountbatten Windsor has been stripped of his royal titles and is being evicted from the rent-free mansion he calls home. His disgrace follows a scandal that’s been 25 years in the making.

results.title: Louise
results.overview: Follows the struggles of Marion in her attempt to reconnect with her family and piece together her fragmented identity after fleeing a troubled childhood.

results.title: The Christmas Spark
results.overview: At Christmastime, a passed-over corporate lawyer joins his small town's fire department, where he competes with a fallen hero's son - and finds unexpected sparks with his widowed mom.

results.title: I Fell in Love with a Z-Grade Director in Brooklyn
results.original_title: I Fell in Love with a Z-Grade Director in Brooklyn
results.overview: A jaded Japanese movie star stranded in NYC without money or phone meets a passionate indie filmmaker and his crew, leading to an unexpected creative journey that could reignite her love for cinema.

results.title: Rearranged
results.overview: Ham, a 15-year-old boy gifted in music, is forbidden by his mother from playing piano after his father abandon the family from his music career. Ham must choose between following his dream or protecting his family’s fragile bond.

results.title: Get Rich or Die Trying
results.overview: When Nicole Bollinger's sister Darcie goes missing and is presumed dead, Nic must investigate what happened to Darcie, take down the multi-level marketing cult that's holding her captive, and learn the true meaning of family.

results.title: Surviving My Father: The Rachel Jeffs Story
results.original_title: Surviving My Father: The Rachel Jeffs Story
results.overview: Warren Jeffs becomes the notorious leader of a polygamous sect known as the FLDS Church. Subjected to her father's abuse and manipulation, Rachel Jeffs plans a daring escape from the heavily guarded community, then returns to rescue her children.

results.title: Lady Maclean
results.overview: On shift at the grand ceilidh, Mairead stands up to her tyrannical employer.

results.title: Shadow Death
results.overview: A mysterious killer roams a small town pulling it's victims into the shadows. As the fatalities rise, dark secrets are revealed.

results.title: Five Seconds
results.overview: Adriano is a middle-aged man living in a dilapidated villa in Tuscany, when a group of young idealistic students arrives to restore the villa's vineyards.

results.title: The Surgeon of Lazarus
results.overview: The Surgeon of Lazarus tells the symbolic story of a fisherman from a fishing village who becomes corrupt due to power and money, leading his village to misery, death and destruction. A mythical work about resurrection, loneliness and death.
